_comment: BL-59 / five-lens round two (2026-10-16). Records written before 2026-10-16 carry the CLI alias the seat was launched with, not the model that answered. Each alias lists its resolutions oldest first; `until` is exclusive (ISO 8601 with offset, the game record's ts is compared to it); the last entry has no `until` and is the current resolution. Evidence: the local CLI transcripts under ~/.claude/projects for this repo (per-day model census, 2026-10-16) and BUG-LOG BL-59 (game 63 on 2026-09-25 was the first on claude-opus-5-5; games 46-62 were claude-opus-5). Records that already carry a concrete id pass through untouched.
